His insistence on integrity, humility, and service continues to shape how we lead and how we work. The culture he set-do the right thing, do it well, and do it together - remains our compass. We are grateful for his legacy and committed to carrying it forward in the way we treat our people, our partners, and our communities. Mohamedali R. Habib Annual Report 2025 09
